# pve_notification_endpoint_webhook (Data Source)

Reads a single webhook notification endpoint from `GET /cluster/notifications/endpoints/webhook/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_notification_endpoint_webhook" "alerting" {
  name = "alerting-hook"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint to look up.

### Read-Only

- `body` (String) HTTP body template (decoded from PVE's base64 storage).
- `comment` (String) Comment.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether this target is disabled.
- `headers` (Map of String) HTTP headers to set, as a `name` to `value` map (decoded from PVE's base64 property strings).
- `method` (String) HTTP method used for the request. Must be one of: `post`, `put`, `get`.
- `secrets` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secrets, as a `name` to `value` map (decoded from PVE's base64 property strings).
- `url` (String) Server URL to send the request to.
